note: Material families of the planner's buildings (server/tools/area_plan_buildings.py, areaplan/prefabs/*.json, server/README.md 'Buildings in the planner (O515)'). A prefab names families, never item ids. A family here is either a decor kit group (the ids come from decor_kits.json, each checked on the pair by check-kits) or a short list of stock ids of the base server's items.xml. Walls, floors and doors come from areagen_config.lua and areaplan_build.lua (`areaplan_build.lua materials`), not from this file. Orientation: `dirs` gives the id that faces n, e, s or w; `h` and `v` give the piece that runs along x or along y. The order of the stock ids that stand for each direction is NOT verified on the pair (the sprites of the base server's items.otb are not in git): check-kits lists them for a look.

counter.source: stock counter pieces 1617-1618 (items.xml: counter); 1620-1621 and 1642-1645 are the other counter pieces

shelf.source: stock bookcase 6368-6371 (items.xml: bookcase, a rotatable container)

locker.source: stock locker 1732-1735 (items.xml: locker, a rotatable container; NOT the depot locker 2589-2592, which needs a depot id)
